audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 were marked Skill and Shen while whys[1] calls Shield Vault 'a free kill setup' and whys[2] says his three-ability burst outpaces you; levels 4-5 and first item were Shen while the prose describes them as merely softening.
audit.why: Packet chart is Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Skill, Skill, Shen. Level 6 stays Pantheon to agree with the already-audited mirror, which justifies that row with Shield Vault cancelling Stand United.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 set as matched full/content pairs with ratings; row 4 left as Pantheon for mirror agreement.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Pantheon at 2-3 on Shield Vault, Stand United at 6, tank item after, tank scaling at two items. Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s and lets him export a lead the same way your R does.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page credits Pantheon's passive with a shield in five places ('his passive shield is up', 'refresh his passive shield'). Mortal Will grants no shield. Aegis Assault is never mentioned at all, despite being the ability that both blanks your commit and hands you a 22-second punish.
audit.why: Mortal Will: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered' — empowerment, no shield. Aegis Assault (E, 400 range, 22/21/20/19/18s) is a channel that makes him invulnerable to damage from the front, so burst dumped into its face is wasted, but a Shadow Dash taunt cancels the channel outright. Shield Vault (W, 600 range, 13/12/11/10/9s) is a point-click stun that ends your Stand United mid-channel.
audit.corrected: Fabricated passive shield removed and replaced with Mortal Will's real effect; Aegis Assault named with its cooldown and both interactions; Shield Vault's channel cancel stated.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Pantheon's Shield Vault is down.
edits.after: Shield Vault (13s at rank 1) is a point-click stun — trade only in the gap after he spends it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Pantheon must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His window: Shield Vault stun into an empowered Comet Spear beats your reaction. Hold the wave your side and give nothing.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — track every low ally. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Pantheon's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Shield Vault's stun cancels Stand United mid-channel and Grand Starfall exports his lead too — start your R outside his 600 dash range.

edits.before: Pantheon's passive shield means he trades autos favorably and his Q poke with range advantage puts you at a deficit before you land a single ability.
edits.after: Mortal Will empowers every few casts and Comet Spear out-ranges you at 575 — he banks a health lead before you land a single ability of your own.

edits.before: Delay committing your E Shadow Dash until Pantheon has burned his passive shield, denying him free auto-block on your taunt
edits.after: Save Shadow Dash for Aegis Assault — the taunt cancels his channel, and its 22s rank-1 cooldown is a long punish window

edits.before: Stack passive Mortal Will charges through Q pokes to refresh his passive shield and nullify your Ki Barrier trades
edits.after: Stack Mortal Will with Comet Spear pokes so his empowered Shield Vault burst arrives faster than your Ki Barrier

edits.before: Level 1 Pantheon wins outright — his Q poke with passive shield up means every auto exchange is in his favor, and your Spirit's Refuge needs the blade placed before you, which he will simply sidestep. Play passive, last-hit at max range, and do not spend E trying to close on him. At level 2, getting Shadow Dash does not fix the problem: he has W point-click stun ready and can stun you before you land the taunt, then burst through your Ki Barrier with an empowered-Q. At level 3, your W-block does start absorbing his follow-up autos, but his stun window is the real kill threat — if he catches you inside minion range with W, he cashes the empowered-Q before your Spirit's Refuge zone is up. Respect the stun range completely in these three levels; the game is not lost, it just has not started yet.
edits.after: Level 1 Pantheon wins outright — Comet Spear out-ranges you at 575 and every auto exchange is in his favor, and your Spirit's Refuge needs the blade placed before you, which he will simply sidestep. Play passive, last-hit at max range, and do not spend E trying to close on him. At level 2, getting Shadow Dash does not fix the problem: Shield Vault is a point-click stun on 13s and he can land it before your taunt, then burst through Ki Barrier with an empowered Comet Spear. At level 3, your W-block does start absorbing his follow-up autos, but the stun window is still the kill threat — if he catches you inside minion range with W, he cashes the empowered spear before your Spirit's Refuge zone is up. Respect his 600 dash range completely in these three levels; the game is not lost, it just has not started yet.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are the true skill-check of this lane: Pantheon's kill pressure gradually softens as his all-in burst pattern stops one-shotting your HP bar, and your E-taunt trades become more meaningful if you bank Ki Barrier stacks before engaging. Hold the wave near your tower, let him shove, and take short trade windows when his passive shield is down and his W is on cooldown — E into him, drop W behind to block his empowered auto follow-up, and Q through the blade. Level 6 is where the matchup flips on the macro level: Grand Starfall lets Pantheon export his lead too, so track the minimap the moment he disappears; but Stand United is your answer — any threatened kill bot lane becomes a 2v1 rescue, and a Pantheon who cannot convert his early lead into kills is a Pantheon who falls off into items. Prioritize TP plays and global peel over fighting a man who out-damages you locally.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are the true skill-check of this lane: Pantheon's kill pressure gradually softens as his all-in burst pattern stops one-shotting your HP bar, and your E-taunt trades become more meaningful if you bank Ki Barrier stacks before engaging. Hold the wave near your tower, let him shove, and take short trade windows once Shield Vault (13s at rank 1) is spent — E into him, drop W behind to block his auto follow-up, and Q through the blade. If he sets Aegis Assault, taunt him: Shadow Dash cancels the channel and never feed damage into its front. Level 6 flips the matchup on the macro level: Grand Starfall lets Pantheon export his lead too, so track the minimap the moment he disappears; Stand United is your answer, and a Pantheon who cannot convert his early lead is a Pantheon who falls off into items.

edits.before: Two items in, this lane is firmly yours — Pantheon's burst no longer threatens your HP bar through Sunfire and stacked HP, his passive shield is irrelevant against your E-taunt damage, and your W-block nullifies his empowered-Q follow-up entirely. Your win condition is teamfight: Stand United onto an engaged ally, W-block the burst, E-taunt multiple targets, and Q through the blade for AoE shred. Pantheon is a side-laner at this stage, not a frontline — force 5v5 teamfights around objectives where his kit contributes little and your global peel defines the fight.

notes: The page invented a passive shield for Pantheon and repeated it in five strings; Mortal Will only empowers his next spell. Aegis Assault was absent entirely and is the ability that most changes how you spend Shadow Dash. Level 6 was left as Pantheon rather than moved to the packet's 'Skill' so the two directions of this matchup keep agreeing — flag for mirror-fix if the packet is preferred.
